ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water always increases oxygen
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Petrol fires have no fuel

2. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

3. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Paper burning to ash
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only water vapour
   D. Only carbon dioxide

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Dressing ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Dressing ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Dressing ENVIRONMENT.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Myself ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Myself ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Myself ENVIRONMENT.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Foods/Feeding PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Care for the teeth PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Care for the teeth PRACTICES.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Care for the teeth PRACTICES.

9. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 50 °C
   C. 37 °C
   D. 100 °C

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

11. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather ENVIRONMENT? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather ENVIRONMENT.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather ENVIRONMENT.

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Sanitation/ PRACTICES? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Sanitation/ PRACTICES.

   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for : OUR SCHOOL.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to : OUR SCHOOL.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about : OUR SCHOOL.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Soil ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Sound ENVIRONMENT and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
